scenes.title: 1 · The problem, and the outcome
scenes.badge:
Real YouCam Clothes V4 result
from the run shown at 1:00
scenes.vo: You have an invitation and an outfit, but you're unsure whether they match. WearCheck checks the stated requirements and helps you preview the smallest change.

scenes.title: 2 · Invitation and confirmation
scenes.badge:
Sample invitation
created for this demo — not a real event
scenes.note: Google Gemini reads the text and proposes requirements, each quoted from the invitation. You confirm or edit them.
scenes.vo: Upload the invitation. This one is a sample made for the demo. Google Gemini reads it and quotes each requirement word for word: formal, flats or wedges on the lawn, and please avoid white or ivory. You confirm them before anything is judged.

scenes.title: 3 · Outfit photo and finding
scenes.badge:
Photo: the project owner,
shown with their permission
scenes.vo: Next, one full-length photo, with consent. The finding names the exact rule it comes from. The invitation says please avoid white or ivory, and the photo shows a white shirt.

scenes.title: 4 · First try-on: a garment
scenes.note: Reference image: ChristianGlaeser, CC BY-SA 3.0. Visual reference, not a shopping listing.

pieces.wait: YouCam Clothes V4: upload, task and generation

scenes.vo: WearCheck suggests one change, from licensed reference images, not shopping listings. Generate sends the photo and the blue shirt to YouCam's Clothes V4 API, the garment try-on. The wait is sped up here. Compare the original and the AI preview, drag the slider, then zoom in on the change. The blue shirt replaced the white shirt, and the vest and tie too. WearCheck doesn't re-check the image, so you judge it.

scenes.title: 5 · Second try-on: shoes
scenes.note: Reference image: Justin Schneider, CC BY-SA 4.0. Visual reference, not a shopping listing.

pieces.wait: YouCam Shoes V3: upload, task and generation

scenes.vo: The shoes were flagged too: the invitation recommends flats or wedges. This second run uses YouCam's Shoes V3 API, with a tan cap-toe oxford. The whole photo stays in view, and the zoom shows the new shoes up close.

scenes.title: 6 · Decision and card
scenes.vo: Choose the result you prefer, and download the decision card. Opening the downloaded file shows the original and the preview, the invitation's requirement, and the recommendation.

scenes.title: 7 · No change needed
scenes.note: Details typed in for a smart-casual dinner with no restrictions.
scenes.vo: A different occasion: a smart-casual dinner with no restrictions. There's nothing to change, so there's no render at all. Keeping what you own is a successful outcome.
scenes.cutNote:
Edited for time: jump cuts between real steps.
